rules.text: My emergency fund never falls below 6 months of living expenses.
I sleep at least 7 hours a night and I do not work more than 55 hours in a week.
Sundays belong to my family. No work on Sundays.
I choose the option where I learn fastest, not the one that pays most.
Once a year I take one bet that scares me.
I never join a company with less than 12 months of runway.
No big decision is final until I have slept on it for 48 hours.
